name: Microsoft SharePoint
shortInfo: A web-based platform used for collaboration and document management within organizations.
brief: Microsoft SharePoint is **a web-based platform used for collaboration and document management within organizations**. It's part of the Microsoft 365 suite and allows users to store, organize, share, and access information securely.
about: Microsoft SharePoint Connector enables streaming Microsoft SharePoint data into a user determined warehouse through DataChannel dashboard. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency. You can transfer data in CSV, JSON and EXCEL formats.
availableData:
[CSV](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_storage/sharepoint/pipelines/csv.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve CSV files/folders (consisting similar structured CSV files). The transfer is enabled irrespective of whether CSV files are compressed or not.

[Excel](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_storage/sharepoint/pipelines/excel.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve Excel files/folders (consisting similar structured Excel files). The transfer is enabled irrespective of whether Excel files are compressed or not.

[JSON](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_storage/sharepoint/pipelines/json.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve JSON files/folders (consisting similar structured JSON files). The transfer is enabled irrespective of whether JSON files are compressed or not.
